instruction: Set up LibreOffice to instantly translate the current document into all six official UN languages and show each translation in adjacent columns.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Writer does not have automatic real-time translation capabilities for multiple languages simultaneously. While LibreOffice has some language tools and can integrate with translation extensions, it cannot automatically translate and display multiple language versions in parallel columns in real-time.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly classified as infeasible - LibreOffice Writer does not have built-in real-time automatic translation to multiple UN languages with parallel column display capabilities
Evaluator correctly uses 'infeasible' function, which is the appropriate handler for tasks that cannot be completed with available software capabilities
Metadata provides clear and accurate explanation of why the task is infeasible
No verification logic is needed or expected for infeasible tasks - the evaluator appropriately indicates this is not accomplishable
